constant_precedence: literature defaults below are OVERRIDDEN, key by key, by calibrated_constants; where a key appears in both (CN1, Tf, Tvl) the calibrated value is the one solved

time_constants_semichords.comment: literature defaults [S6]; Tf and Tvl are superseded by calibrated_constants

separation_model.method: inverse-Kirchhoff fit of f(alpha) to static_polar_reference.csv
separation_model.comment: no alpha1/S1/S2 exponential fit is used: the separation law is recovered in closed form from the measured polar

dynamic_stall_onset.comment: literature default for critical CN; the SOLVED value is calibrated_constants.CN1

calibrated_constants.comment: single source of truth; calibrated against REAL NACA 0012 frame 9302 (10deg+/-10deg, M0.30, k0.10) from NASA TM-84245

field_reconstruction.method: constant-strength source panels (flow tangency) + elliptic bound vortex sheet matched to the UIBS C_L + Lamb-Oseen dynamic-stall vortex
field_reconstruction.comment: grid_*_solution are the sizes actually written to 05_solution/field_*.csv
